name: [UPDATE!] Gumball Factory Tycoon 🍬
desc:
💸 UPDATE: Your money will now increase while you're offline!
🌟 NEW CODE AT 170K+ LIKES!

Welcome to Gumball Factory Tycoon! 🍬

🍬 Gather gumballs from the gumball machine on the way down to your factory! Purchase different flavors to earn more money!

CODES:
➡️AMAZINGTYCOON - 2x money and 5 minutes of sugar rush!
➡️YAY160K - 3x money and 15 minutes of sugar rush!

Be sure to give it a 👍 and favorite for more EXCITING updates on the way!

If your gumballs are stuck in a spiral loop, hit the green button in front of your machine! This will remove all gumballs from your factory to clear all possible complications.

💖 This idea was created thanks to the inspiration of Fruit Juice Tycoon: Remastered!
